title: German Pasta Bake
description: A hearty German-inspired pasta bake with a creamy sauce and a crispy top.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, combine sour cream, yummy, and a pinch of salt.
Stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Combine cooked pasta and sauce in a large bowl.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish.
Top with additional yummy and a sprinkle of german.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
